description: SFLOW semi-implicit step with the coupled non-hydrostatic pressure (A 210 12, A 220 3): 2D basin 14 x 8 m, h = 0.45 m, Gaussian mound (S 53, crest 0.1 m below still water), regular waves H = 5 mm, T = 2 s, dx = 0.1 m, automatic time step (no A 228: 20 steps per period of a 10-cell wave with the model phase speed). The waves refract and focus behind the mound.
covers: sflow_momentum_SI_nh 2D: FGMRES and the two-V-cycle preconditioner
sflow_timestep_SI::wave_cap (automatic time step, A 228 not given)
